entries.text: Traditionally, we rely on banks to move money. They are the middleman.
Bitcoin removes the middleman. It uses a shared ledger called a blockchain.
Thousands of computers verify every transaction, making it secure and transparent.
It is a decentralized way to store and send value. That is Bitcoin.

narration.fullTranscript: What exactly is Bitcoin? Traditionally, we rely on banks to move money. They are the middleman. Bitcoin removes the middleman. It uses a shared ledger called a blockchain. Thousands of computers verify every transaction, making it secure and transparent. It is a decentralized way to store and send value. That is Bitcoin.
